Enum Class HistoryOutcome

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Enum<HistoryOutcome>
de.eldoria.companies.components.order.HistoryOutcome
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable, Comparable<HistoryOutcome>, Constable, net.kyori.adventure.translation.Translatable
public enum HistoryOutcome extends Enum<HistoryOutcome> implements net.kyori.adventure.translation.Translatable
How an order ended, as recorded in the order history.

Every history entry belongs to one side of the order: the owner or the company that worked on it. An entry never names the other side, which keeps orders anonymous.
